summary: Revise at 5.4 (Caiman 7, ship bar 7.5, Corvus was cut at 6.6). One recorded gate fails: the author's own asserted land 'ruby_collet_to_petal_mm' is 0.70, under the 0.8 mm investment minimum section. That alone forces a revise. Every other gate in report.json is green: the export block has cold reload true, and the template gate passed with 1 design.set patch and 528,319 of 1,000,000 bytes. Art-wise, the face just about reads as a rose window at 300 px. The pierced wheel, the lone ruby at the hub, the outer order and the corner trefoils carry it, and dropping the sapphires was right. Everything off the face lets it down. (1) The 'spokes' added after read-test 4 are flat rectangular sticks laid on top of the tracery (walls.png, stones.png). They stop short of the oculus collet with a gap, run past the outer order with square butt ends, and float over the openings. The curved petal arcs underneath still trace a lotus or mandala. (2) The cheek 'gallery arcade' is a flat rectangular plate glued onto the cheek. Its three lancets did not cut properly: walls.png, side.png and end.png show L-shaped scratches, sliver wedges with combed triangles and bright hairline sills, never a pointed lancet. (3) The 'oculi of the nave' are not pierced openings. They are proud stacked coin-like discs standing off the shoulder past the shank silhouette (shoulder.png, side.png), and they read as rivets or washers. (4) The table is a slab stacked on the cushion head ('lifted clear of the metal'), which hides the factory stock's own wall-to-face angle and reads as stacked boxes. (5) The ruby collet shows a ring of saw-tooth artefacts at its foot (stones.png, walls.png). Density next to Caiman and the Reptilia sheet is far lower: big plain surfaces on the cheeks, shoulders and shank, and no medium or small scale at all off the face. A concrete round can fix the land and replace the three broken off-face systems with cut, sculpted ones, so this is revise, not cut.
strengths: face-300 reads as a rose window without the caption: a dark pierced wheel, a single ruby at the hub, a raised outer order, and trefoil bosses in the four corners that point to Gothic.
The ruby-only rethink works: the darkness reads as glass between gold bars, not as a background behind a flower cluster.
The pierced tracery outlines on the table are crisp at close-up (stones.png): clean arcs, no combing on the lights themselves.
The palm is plain and polished as planned, and the ruby's à jour pilot opens cleanly into the bore (palm.png).

Gates are well documented: watertight, 0 degenerates, 0 self-crossings on the ring, the pattern and all 18 made parts, Castable, thickness 0 below 0.8 mm on the sampled rays, cold reload identical, template passed.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The rose lives on the table alone. The cheek panel is a blank plate with broken cuts, the shoulder discs read as rivets, and the shank is plain. The cathedral does not carry down the ring; the off-face elements look stuck on, not part of one building.

checklist.item: Reads as its Gothic subject at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: Narrowly. face-300 reads as a rose window, helped by the corner trefoils. hero-300 reads as a rose-window signet, but the curved petal arcs still pull toward 'lotus or mandala medallion', and nothing off the face says Gothic.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true, crisp outlines
checklist.reason: Gallery arcade (feature 29/30): the lancets render as L-shaped scratches, sliver wedges with combed triangles, and bright hairline sills (walls.png, side.png, end.png), not three pointed arches. The collet foot shows a saw-tooth ring (stones.png). The 16-cusp inner rim does not render at all.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, à jour, visible, coloured as stained glass
checklist.reason: One ruby in a drawn collet, ruby-tinted, pilot drilled through to the bore (palm.png). Marginal: the collet is a plain flat-topped tube, the saw-tooth artefact at its foot needs fixing, and a 1 mm pilot under a 3.5 mm stone lets little light through.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The spokes are flat rectangular bars with square butt ends laid over the tracery. The gallery panel is a flat rectangular plate. The shoulder oculi are stacked flat discs. The table is a flat slab stacked on the head. None of the tracery carries a moulding or chamfer (house rule 10).

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The lifted table slab overhangs the 001 cushion's face edge, so the stock's own crisp wall-to-face angle is replaced by a stacked step (side.png, end.png, walls.png).

checklist.item: Distinct silhouette; custom heads ≥ 13 mm; shoulder ornament not cut off before the face
checklist.reason: A 19 × 19 mm cushion with a round pierced rose is distinct from the other Tenebrae rings. The head is well over 13 mm. The shoulder discs stop short of the head, but that is a design gap, not a cut-off.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large form (the wheel) only. There is no medium or small scale off the table: cheeks, shoulders and shank are open plain gold. That is far below Caiman's hero and the Reptilia signets.

gates.gate: 0 self-crossings on the ring and every made part
gates.verified: ring_self_crossings 0; all 18 made_part_self_crossings entries 0; pattern 0. Note that the render artefacts on features 29/30 and the collet foot should be checked in section even so.

No sand pass and no draft clamp in a lost-wax build (process LostWax, sand null), so not applicable

export triangles 43,414 (verification.json reports 65,012 for the template mesh). Both are well under 2 M. Oddity: the draft and export blocks report identical triangle and thickness figures despite different builds.

gates.gate: Template gate: ≤ 4 design.set patches within class budget
gates.verified: 1 patch (/manufacturing), template_bytes 528,319 ≤ 1,000,000 stock budget, template_gate_passed true, source_identical true

punch_list.zone: Table: 'Oculus collet' bearing (#14-16) against the petal/lancet tracery (#6-8), r ≈ 2.0-2.8 mm
punch_list.change: Open the ruby collet to petal land from 0.70 to at least 0.85 mm, either by shrinking the inner tracery ring's inner radius by 0.15 mm or by trimming the collet bearing OD by 0.15 mm. Assert it in the author script. While there, remove the saw-tooth artefact ring at the collet foot (re-mesh the bearing ring at a finer segment count, or fillet its join with blend 0.1).
punch_list.acceptance: report.json lands.ruby_collet_to_petal_mm ≥ 0.80 in both draft and export blocks. stones.png shows a smooth unbroken collet foot with no triangle teeth.

punch_list.zone: Table: 'Raise the spokes over the tracery' (#80-82) and the curved petal arcs of #6, 8 bar lines between the lancets, r 2.75 to 7.2
punch_list.change: Delete the floating stick spokes. Rebuild the tracery net so that each lancet's sides are straight radial mullions, 1.0 mm wide, that join the oculus order and the outer order with no gap and no overshoot, and bend only at each lancet's pointed head. Give the mullions and both orders a rounded or chamfered top (0.15-0.2 mm) instead of a flat top. Stand the mullions 0.2-0.3 mm over the arch heads.
punch_list.acceptance: face-300: eight straight gold spokes counted from the collet to the outer order, and no gold arc continuing from one light into the next. walls.png and stones.png: no bar end sits past the outer order or short of the collet, no bar floats over an opening, and every bar top shows a soft highlight edge.

punch_list.zone: Both cheeks, features 23-30 ('Gallery panel', 'Gallery arcade'), θ ≈ 90, under the table rim
punch_list.change: Remove the added rectangular panel plate. Cut the three-lancet-on-sill arcade straight into the stock cheek, 0.6 mm deep, lancets ≥ 0.8 mm wide with pointed heads, filling ≥ 60% of the wall height, plus a 0.3 mm sill moulding under it. Mirror it to the far cheek and add the same arcade to both end walls (θ ≈ 90 ± 38). Fix the cutter so each lancet is a single closed region; the current one leaves L-shaped scratches and sliver wedges.
punch_list.acceptance: walls.png, side.png and end.png: three closed, dark, pointed lancets with crisp outlines on each wall, no sliver triangles, no white hairline artefacts, and no proud rectangular plate. hero-300: three or more lancets countable on the visible cheek.

punch_list.zone: Shoulders, features 18-22 ('Oculi of the nave'), θ 90 − (44…74) and mirror
punch_list.change: Replace the proud stacked discs with pierced or sunk openings: 4 round or quatrefoil oculi at 1.6, 1.4, 1.2 and 0.9 mm, cut ≥ 0.6 mm deep (pierced to the bore where lands allow), each framed by a 0.3 mm roll moulding that stands ≤ 0.2 mm proud and blends into the shank (blend 0.15). Nothing may stand past the shank's own silhouette.
punch_list.acceptance: shoulder.png and hero-300: four dark, graded openings countable on the near shoulder, stepping smaller toward the palm. side.png: shank outline unbroken by any proud disc.

punch_list.zone: Table slab (#2 'Table, lifted clear of the metal') and its junction with the 001 head walls
punch_list.change: Seat the rose into the stock's face instead of on a lifted slab: sink the table plane to the stock face, or trim the slab inside the stock face edge by ≥ 0.5 mm with a 0.2 mm chamfer, so the factory head keeps its own hard wall-to-face angle.
punch_list.acceptance: side.png, end.png and walls.png: one crisp factory edge between face and wall, with no stacked step or overhanging plate.

punch_list.zone: 16-cusp inner rim inside the outer order, r ≈ 6.6-7.2, and the outer order itself
punch_list.change: Make the cusped rim actually render: 16 cusps ≥ 0.5 mm deep, dark behind them, and turn the outer order into a half-round roll moulding 0.6 mm wide standing 0.4 mm proud.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png and stones.png: 16 countable cusps. face-300: the cusped rim shows as a scalloped dark ring inside a rounded gold order.

punch_list.zone: Shank from the shoulder oculi to the palm, and the four corner trefoil bosses
punch_list.change: Add medium and small scale to reach Caiman's density: a running cusped-arcade or quatrefoil frieze (0.2-0.3 mm relief, true-outline stamps) along both shank edges from the shoulders to θ 90 − 110 and mirror, with the palm left plain. Dome or chamfer the corner trefoils so they read carved, not extruded.
punch_list.acceptance: hero.png: large (rose), medium (arcade, oculi) and small (frieze, cusps) forms all visible, with no plain run of shank longer than about 6 mm above the palm zone. Trefoils show a highlight gradient, not a flat top.
